items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: In fact, I remember the time Howard saved Louis Armstrong's lip.

ctx.x: I remember people like Howard Vorees, another fine cornet trumpet man, Howard, very fine. In fact, I remember the time Howard saved Louis Armstrong's lip. How was that? With a mouthpiece and with making him play in the center of his mouth. You know, Louis – I remember the days Louis used to run over to the curb when he was playing in the street parade. And rubbed that mouthpiece on the concrete and stick it up in his lip and start blowing. Oh man, he'd really blow it out then, you know. Had that mouthpiece just…
